reasons: CS3210 prerequisite (CS2100/CS2100DE/CS2100HS/CG2028/EE2028/CG2007/EE2024) is not satisfied by completed courses and cannot be completed by Semester 5 given the 8 MC limit and prerequisite chains for those courses.

CS3236 requires MA1100/MA1100T/CS1231/CS1231S AND (EE2012/EE2012A/MA2216/MA2116/MA2116T/ST2131/ST2334). ST2334 is a must-take, but EE2012/MA2116 etc. are not in the must-take list and their prerequisites (MA1511/MA1512 or MA1100/CS1231) are not completed, making CS3236 impossible to take.

CS2102 requires CS1231/MA1100/MA1100T/CS1231S AND (CS2030S/CS2030/CS2030DE/CS2030HS/YSC2229/CS2040/CS2040C/CS2040S/CS2040DE/CS2040HS). The student has CS1231S and CS2030S/CS2040S, so CS2102 is eligible. However, the other blockers make a valid plan impossible.
